title: mapania palustris var. andamanica
intro: Mapania palustris var. andamanica, commonly known as Andaman Mapania, is a variant of the Mapania palustris plant species, which belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Mapania palustris var. andamanica include wound healing, antipyretic, and anti-diarrheal activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to possess antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a potential candidate for the development of novel therapeutics.
